    The concrete corner category of a primitive-projective presentation #

    A complete primitive-projective presentation realizes the selected projective category by the literal corners e_q A e_p. This auxiliary category keeps ambient algebra coordinates as the morphism type, which is the convenient form for the finite-ideal pencil argument. Its canonical linear functor to the existing selected-projective category is fully faithful and bijective on objects.
